text:
nina: Quick announce: we're opening H200 spot/ephemeral pools in sa-east-1 (Sao Paulo) and us-west-2 (Oregon) for limited preview next week. These are cheaper but preemptible; intended for batch/async inference and background retraining.

olivia: Nice. Are we calling them 'spot' or 'ephemeral'? Need consistent naming for docs and billing.

nina: We'll use 'spot' in public docs, 'ephemeral' internally to avoid confusion with cloud spot terminology.

han: What preemption behavior? any advance notice?

nina: Preemptions will be signaled via the runtime (60180s notice depending on load). We'll publish a per-zone preemption distribution and a risk score for each reservation.

raj: Billing / invoice tagging? Customers will want to distinguish.

finance-bot: [billing-plan] spot_h200_rate = 1.6x reserved_h200_rate; session min charge = 60s.

nina: We'll tag every allocation with `pool_type=spot` or `pool_type=reserved` and include pool_id on usage exports.

han: Need API hooks so customers can prefer cheaper but riskier pools.

nina: Added small opt into the reservations API: `pool_preference: "reserved" | "spot" | "auto"` and `allow_preemption: true|false`. Example CLI: 

```
redwoodctl reservations create --model h200 --region sa-east-1 --count 4 --pool-preference spot --allow-preemption true
```

olivia: Autoscaler note: mark spot nodes as no-kv-warm. don't move pinned state into them.

han: Agreed. Also set cool-down on fallback to avoid flapping between pools.

ops-bot: [capacity-snapshot] sa-east-1 (preview cluster): spot cap: 32 GPUs; reserved cap: 48. us-west-2 (preview): spot: 40; reserved: 120.

raj: Migration plan for customers on older SKU (L4, rtx) who want H200 spot?

nina: No auto-migrations. We'll surface an opt-in migration flow in Console with cost comparison and projected performance. 30-day opt-in window for preview users.

olivia: Support runbook? Who owns?

han: SRE + support. I'll draft the runbook and include sample customer emails and TL;DR for AE.

nina: Timeline:
- 2026-05-18: preview announcement + docs (internal)
- 2026-05-25: limited preview open to invited accounts
- 2026-06-08: expand spot capacity if preview stable

raj: Any impact on SLA?

nina: No SLA for spot pools. Reserved pools keep existing SLA unchanged.

finance-bot: Reminder: customers using spot may see higher egress and retry costs if they don't handle preemption gracefully.

olivia: OK. I'll prepare an AE one-pager and a sample snippet for SDK retries/backoff.

han: One more: add a console toggle so accounts can opt-out of spot entirely at org level.

nina: Good call. Will add `org_disallow_spot` flag to account settings by GA.

ops-bot: [action] nina: share preview invite list by EOD today.

nina: Will do. DM me if you have an account to include. :thumbsup:
